description: Redirect of the α_EM per-loop measure search after #3870 ruled out the naive Maxwell partition function on the photon target J(M)=T^{b₁} (b₁=8). Tests the next-obvious normalization objects — Ray–Singer analytic torsion (A) and the graded/per-mode determinant ratios (B) — against the three-axis constraint #3870 sharpened: the object must be (i) area/covolume-free, (ii) π-power EXACTLY −1 (bare π), (iii) reciprocal in b₁ (1/b₁). Target: 1/(π·b₁)=1/(8π). Each candidate is measured independently then COMPARED (never fitted); no CODATA read; no convention tuned to 8π. RESULT — scope-(a) NEGATIVE on all: (A) on the flat parallelizable torus Δq=C(d,q)Δ₀ so log τ_RS = ½ ζ'_Δ₀(0)·Σ_q(−1)^q q C(d,q), and Σ_q(−1)^q q C(d,q)=0 for d≥2 ⇒ τ_RS(T^8)=1 (analytic torsion TRIVIAL; the π in ζ'_Δ₀(0)=log(4π²)+E'_Λ(0) CANCELS in the alternating sum) — π-power 0 (not −1), no reciprocal-b₁; the residual metric-on-cohomology normalization is the covolume √det G (Cheeger–Müller=Reidemeister), shape-dependent, in the 1/Area category data-excluded at −1419 ppb (#3842). (B) the alternating det ratio ∏(det'Δq)^{(−1)^q q/2}=1/τ_RS=1 and the per-mode derivative d(logZ)/db₁=−½log(2π)+const is b₁-INDEPENDENT — no graded/per-mode object on T^{b₁} is reciprocal in b₁. CONTROLS all pass: ζ_Δ₁(0)=−b₁ reproduced; the ζ'(0) machinery reproduces the circle closed form ζ'_S¹(0)=−2logL (det'Δ=L²) for L=1,2,3.7 and E'_ℤ(0)=−2log(2π); the torsion weight Σ_q(−1)^q q C(d,q)=−1 (d=1), 0 (d≥2). SHARPENED REDIRECT (C): every flat-torus spectral invariant is EXTENSIVE in b₁ (ζ(0)=−b₁, ζ'(0)∝b₁, logZ∝b₁) or a covolume (torsion) — never 1/b₁; a reciprocal 1/b₁ is a 1/(total count) democratic-average normalization, the hallmark of the RT/WRT modular S-matrix total quantum dimension D=Σd_i² (S_{00}=1/D) / Verlinde per-handle measure, living OFF the flat-torus determinant on the nonabelian S-matrix (Front 2 / W_λ keystone), NOT any determinant/torsion on the Jacobian. No α_k wired; no fit; 1/(8π) stays a phase-4 identification.
